tests.title: Heart rate
tests.instruction: Rest in a restrained position. Read heart rate on the onboard monitor and enter it.

tests.title: Systolic blood pressure
tests.instruction: Rest in a restrained position. Read systolic blood pressure on the onboard monitor and enter it.

tests.instruction: Rest in a restrained position. Read diastolic blood pressure on the onboard monitor and enter it.

tests.title: Oxygen saturation
tests.instruction: Rest in a restrained position. Read oxygen saturation on the onboard monitor and enter it.

tests.title: Body temperature
tests.instruction: Rest in a restrained position. Read body temperature on the onboard monitor and enter it.

tests.title: Pain score
tests.instruction: Rest in a restrained position. Enter a pain score from 0 to 10.

immediateSteps.title: Stop exercise and rest in a restrained position
immediateSteps.instruction: Stop the session and stay restrained.

immediateSteps.title: Tell a crewmate and keep them nearby
immediateSteps.instruction: Call a crewmate and ask them to stay within reach.

immediateSteps.title: Do not resume exercise until the flight surgeon clears it
immediateSteps.instruction: Wait for flight surgeon clearance before any more exercise.

immediateSteps.title: Re-measure heart rate and blood pressure and enter the results
immediateSteps.instruction: Take both readings again at rest and enter them.

immediateSteps.title: Send the case to the flight surgeon
immediateSteps.instruction: Continue to handoff and send the case.

cautions: This is a demonstration protocol, not a diagnosis. Contact the flight surgeon before using anything from the kit.
sourceNote: Demonstration protocol written by the team for a hackathon prototype. Pending researcher review. Not a NASA protocol.
